results.question: 2026年8月每个项目的租金收缴率是多少？从高到低。
results.generated_sql:
WITH project_receivables AS (
    SELECT
        p.property_id,
        p.property_name,
        SUM(rp.amount_due) AS total_amount_due,
        SUM(rp.amount_paid) AS total_amount_paid
    FROM properties p
    JOIN units u ON p.property_id = u.property_id
    JOIN leases l ON u.unit_id = l.unit_id
    JOIN rent_payments rp ON l.lease_id = rp.lease_id
    WHERE rp.billing_month = '2026-08-01'
    GROUP BY p.property_id, p.property_name
)
SELECT
    property_name,
    CASE
        WHEN total_amount_due = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE total_amount_paid / total_amount_due
    END AS collection_rate
FROM project_receivables
ORDER BY collection_rate DESC;
results.summary: 统计2026年8月账期各项目的租金收缴率（实收/应收），按比率从高到低排序。
disclosures: 租金收缴率按账期统计，等于同一账期实收租金除以应收租金，不按到账日混入往期回款。
